title: Spanish Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Spanish rice bowl with a kick of zesty flavor. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the arroz negro, zesty tomato sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.
